messages.body: Hi Alex, your annual Pro plan renews on Nov 30 at $2,400. Teams on your usage often upgrade to Team for shared workspaces. Want me to set up a quick call?

note.text: Alex decided to cancel the Quillstack Pro plan at renewal and move to the free tier. The cancellation request has not been submitted yet.

question: Do I need to do anything about this renewal?
fact: The owner decided to cancel the plan at renewal and move to the free tier, but has not yet submitted the cancellation.
